react.description:
A single tab inside a `Tabs` tablist; renders as a link when `href` is
provided, otherwise as a button.

tags.devx:
- `label` can come from string children; selection is index-based and
  owned by the parent `Tabs` -- there is no standalone `selected` prop.
tags.a11y:
- Exposes `id`, roving `tabIndex` (`0` on the selected or fallback tab,
  `-1` otherwise), and `aria-controls` pointing at the matching
  `TabPanel` when the tab list is connected to a `TabPanels`.
- `disabled` sets the native `disabled` attribute for a button tab, or
  `aria-disabled` and a blocked click for a link tab.
tags.limitations:
- Horizontal layout only; there is no vertical tablist orientation.
- A truncated label has no built-in tooltip.

className.name: className
className.description: Classes or state-aware element classes applied through the shared style contract.

label.name: label
label.description: Text shown for this tab; can also come from a string child.

disabled.name: disabled
disabled.description: Disables pointer, keyboard, and roving-tabindex focus for this tab.

index.name: index
index.description: Injected by the parent Tabs: position of this tab in the list.

selectedTab.name: selectedTab
selectedTab.description: Injected by the parent Tabs: index of the currently selected tab.

tabsId.name: tabsId
tabsId.description: Injected by the parent Tabs: identifier shared by every tab and panel of the group.

href.name: href
href.description: Navigation destination; switches the inner element to a native link.

isFocusable.name: isFocusable
isFocusable.description: Injected by the parent Tabs: this tab is the roving-tabindex stop while nothing is selected.

hasPanels.name: hasPanels
hasPanels.description: Injected by the parent Tabs: whether a connected TabPanels exists (wires aria-controls).

onTabSelect.name: onTabSelect
onTabSelect.description: Injected by the parent Tabs: requests this tab becomes selected.

angular.description:
A single tab inside a `lib-tabs` tablist; renders as a link when `href` is
provided, otherwise as a button.

tags.devx:
- `label` and `icon` are the tab's content; selection is index-based and
  owned by the parent `lib-tabs` -- there is no standalone `selected` input.
tags.a11y:
- Exposes `id`, roving `tabIndex` (`0` on the selected or fallback tab,
  `-1` otherwise), and `aria-controls` pointing at the matching
  `lib-tab-panel` when the tab list is connected to a `lib-tab-panels`.
- `disabled` sets the native `disabled` attribute for a button tab, or
  `aria-disabled` and a blocked click for a link tab.
tags.limitations:
- Horizontal layout only; there is no vertical tablist orientation.
- A truncated label has no built-in tooltip.
